notes:
磁贴连接更可靠。

- 修复 iOS 多文件选择时同名文件相互覆盖、导致订阅导入没有结果的问题。
- 修复 Android 快捷设置磁贴在冷启动时没有连接、或者连接后又断开的问题。连接意图等待启动恢复完成后执行；重复通知和平台回复超时不会再次切换连接。
- iOS 主应用和 VPN 扩展补全隐私清单，并检查最终安装包是否真正包含对应声明。
- 连接质量观察补齐系统区域设置来源，帮助区分不同用户群组；不新增位置采集或后台测速，仍遵守已有参与设置。
- 更新至 Flutter 3.47.5 / Dart 3.13.4 与 AGP 9.4.1 / Gradle 9.7.1 / Kotlin 2.4.20，带入最新稳定补丁与 Android 打包修复。
- 修复 iOS 连接、断开重叠时旧超时移除新监听的问题，并补齐 macOS 随包隐私声明校验。
- 支持同一幂等键的短时等待重试，支付、提现等处理中请求可自动取得原操作结果。
- Android 撤销 VPN 后重新连接会等待原生停止完成，重复撤销共享同一收尾；桌面 TUN 模式清理系统代理后会确认结果。
- 修复 XHTTP 上行请求失败后仍等待下行、连接长时间挂起的问题，并及时释放遗留请求。
notesEn:
More reliable tile connections.

- Update the iOS file picker to fix concurrent copies of identically named files silently returning no import results.
- Fix Android Quick Settings taps that failed to connect after cold launch or connected then immediately disconnected. Explicit intent runs after startup recovery; duplicate wakeups and delayed native replies no longer repeat the toggle.
- Bundle privacy manifests for the iOS app and VPN extension, and validate both in the final package.
- Include the system-locale source in connection-quality cohorts. No new location collection or background speed testing; existing participation settings still apply.
- Update to Flutter 3.47.5 / Dart 3.13.4 and AGP 9.4.1 / Gradle 9.7.1 / Kotlin 2.4.20 with current stable patches and the Android packaging repair.
- Isolate iOS VPN observers per operation so stale timeouts cannot remove a newer connection or stop observer; verify the macOS privacy resource in the shipped app.
- Retry temporary in-flight replies using the same idempotency key so pending financial operations can resolve to the original result.
- Wait for Android VPN revocation teardown before reconnecting, coalesce duplicate revokes, and confirm desktop TUN system-proxy cleanup.
- Fail XHTTP stream-up promptly when an upload or response body fails, and release the outstanding download request.
